mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_records ( tenant_id, alarm_rule_id, product_id, device_id, project_id, level, status, title, content, trigger_value, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{record.tenantId}, #{record.alarmRuleId}, #{record.productId}, #{record.deviceId}, #{record.projectId}, #{record.level}, #{record.status}, #{record.title}, #{record.content}, #{record.triggerValue}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, alarm_rule_id, device_id) WHERE status IN ('TRIGGERED', 'CONFIRMED') DO NOTHING
